description: Responses a fake parser returns for stream 3. No model and no network. Keys are exact user_text. A text missing from both maps falls through to default. 'raises' makes the turn parser raise RuntimeError; parse_turn_intent catches that and the graph still increments turn.

cannot_express.several_lock_intents: TurnIntentExtraction.turn_intent is one value and slot_index is one integer. locks[] is several attrs on that one slot. A list of intents fails model_validate.
cannot_express.full_builds_on_bootstrap: BootstrapExtraction has direction_text, anchor_text, pool_entries, delegated, ownership_mode. extra=forbid. A builds key becomes a bootstrap parse error.
